prompts.name: Fire Talon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single game weapon sprite for a top-down 2D fantasy survivor game. Crisp detailed pixel-art with dark one-pixel-style outlines, faceted highlights, limited rich palette, strong readable silhouette matching a blue crystal ice gauntlet sprite. ONE isolated object only, centered, pointing straight UP with handle/wrist at bottom. Square canvas with generous transparent padding on every side. Actual transparent background. No ground, cast shadow, text, labels, border, character, hand, background, extra objects or UI. This is a usable equipment sprite, not a concept sheet. A single phoenix talon gauntlet weapon, a compact charcoal-red and gold armoured wrist with three long hooked orange-gold claw blades pointing upward, small bright yellow ember edges, small restrained red flame details integrated into the blades. Opaque solid weapon silhouette, no diffuse glow. Claws dominate, chunky and readable.
